record.source_text: (1) If fixed assets are sold, the hidden reserves disclosed thereby may be deducted from the acquisition or production costs, or from the partial amounts of the acquisition or production costs within the meaning of Section 10(7), second sentence, of fixed assets acquired or produced in the financial year of the sale.
